'''Bonadan alloy''' was a heavy alloy material created on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. It was used to create [[Bonadan alloy heavy suit]]s, which saw use during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
